name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos deposit hosts Measured and Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold, making it one of the largest undeveloped silver deposits in the world. The company is advancing toward a development decision and is backed by strategic shareholders including Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott.
